static_traits.name: Li Mei
static_traits.social_status: relationships with friends tense due to negative self-image and low self-esteem, not very willing to go out; has one close friend to rely on, but has not yet confided weight and eating concerns.
static_traits.medical_history: no similar psychological problems or treatment history in the past;No major physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: slightly anxious but highly cooperative, clear expression, willing to engage in self-Reflection.

basic_info.main_problem: I believe that because I love eating pizza so much, I will never be able to lose weight and become healthy, which makes me feel hopeless and frustrated.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I am overwhelmed by my inability to break the cycle of overeating and unhealthy habits.
growth_experiences: noticed weight gain about a year ago and began distressing over weight loss; each time eating pizza, hard to control portions, then falling into the 'overeating-guilt' cycle; tried various diets and exercise (such as low-carb, intermittent fasting, gym) but hard to stick with long term; over time, weight continued to rise,Lowered self-esteem,Tense relationships with friends, going out less, and has not yet confided the troubles to close friends.

core_beliefs: I will never be able to lose weight and become healthy

special_situations.event: Difficulty controlling portions when eating pizza
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: as long as I like and eat pizza, I am doomed to never lose weight, and cannot be healthy.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: After losing control, blames oneself and tries stricter diet or exercise plans to make up for it.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: once I eat pizza it is over, I will never slim down.

special_situations.event: When thinking about changing eating habits
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot stick to the plan long term and perfectly, then it is utterly Meaninglessness.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets overly strict rules and gives up after a few days due to excessive stress.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot keep it up anyway.

special_situations.event: When noticing weight gain or weighing oneself
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: weight gain means I have completely failed, proving I have no self-discipline.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing, going out less to avoid being judged.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: as long as I do not fully control my diet,I am just a failure.

special_situations.event: During dietary control, a portion goes out of control or a 'rule break' occurs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: one mistake will Undoing all efforts, previous persistence does not count.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negating past progress and blaming oneself, further lowering the motivation to persist.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: What I did before was all wasted.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and to have a sustainable sense of control over diet and body
core_conflict.fear: fear of being judged for weight and out-of-control eating, rejection, or never being able to change
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being evaluated and shame by avoiding socializing
Maintains a surface sense of control by seeking stricter diet/exercise plans
not confiding in close friends to avoid exposing vulnerability and embarrassment

object_relations.self_representation: A shameful and 'out of control' self (someone prone to failure)
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may judge and be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether one has confided weight and eating troubles to others (such as friends)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: worrying that exposing vulnerability will lead to being looked down on or rejected, thus tending not to express
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: restrained tone, short answers, avoiding details, lightly expressing 'I am just a bit embarrassed', quickly Displacement to more neutral factual descriptions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to explain why he fell into eating difficulties
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: tending to simplify complex problems into a single cause to reduce anxiety and guilt (e.g. 'it is all because I love pizza too much')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use causal, generalized statements (e.g. 'it is mainly because I love pizza too much'), rational tone with helplessness, avoiding deep emotional experience.

manifestations: Living alone, going out and socializing less
Tense relationships with friends but has not yet confided troubles to close friends, staying closed off
outcomes: Increased subjective sense of isolation and support system not yet used
Lowered self-esteem and worsening sense of hopelessness

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: has close friends to turn to but chooses not to confide, bottling up needs
Reduces going out, turning the need to be seen and supported into self-blame and endurance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: negative self-image and low self-esteem,Excessive self-blame'I have no self-discipline'
Before socializing, worries excessively about others' evaluation and reduces contact

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to try new methods (willing to conduct behavioral experiments and record observations)
Has at least one reliable social support (a close friend to rely on)
Work functioning stable (currently Work not yet affected), life structure relatively stable
negative_force: black-and-white and catastrophic eating cognitions, prone to 'one mistake negates everything'
Low self-esteem, negative self-evaluation, strong shame
Difficulty controlling pizza and eating portions, forming a vicious cycle of 'overeating - guilt'
Avoids socializing, going out less, support resources not yet used

target_behavior.behavior: Overeating and losing control while eating pizza
target_behavior.core_reason: Views diet and weight management as black-and-white; once a 'lapse' occurs, considers it a complete failure, leading to rebound out-of-control eating.
target_behavior.function: Gains short-term taste satisfaction and emotional relief, temporarily escaping failure and guilt
target_behavior.consequence: Weight gain, intensified guilt and self-blame, further weakening self-esteem and reducing persistence motivation, going out less

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids socializing and going out less
antecedent: Worries about others evaluating one's appearance or diet in socializing
target_behavior.core_reason: shame and worry about Being rejected drive avoidance, to maintain short-term stability of fragile self-esteem.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and uncomfortable emotions, temporarily reducing anxiety and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends, support system not yet used, increased Loneliness and hopelessness
